messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Fifth protocol. The creature imitates your posture, your rhythm, and some military reflexes. It learns fast, maybe too fast.

choices.label: I give it a simple order to test obedience.
I give it a puzzle to measure its understanding.
I turn the imitation into play to see what it invents.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The imitation drifts. It repeats your gestures, but adds micro-movements that do not come from you.

choices.label: I interrupt the sequence before it learns bad habits.
I compare every deviation to understand its thinking.
I accept this imperfect version of my gesture.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: If it copies your violence, it can become a weapon. If it copies your doubt, it can become something else.

choices.label: I prioritize discipline: it must respond quickly.
I prioritize curiosity: it must search before acting.
I prioritize empathy: it must feel before copying.
